Implemented and merged: change 1058, commit eea930a64e20.

[operator-attested] End-to-end verification on scratch ticket cf19-d1e0-e817-4510, run against merged main:

1. First review as a `task`  -> verdict BLOCK, runner pydantic_ai, ticket_type task   (a real run)
2. Second review, unchanged  -> verdict BLOCK, runner reused                          (reuse still works; no spurious re-review)
3. Retyped task -> bug, review -> verdict PASS,  runner pydantic_ai, ticket_type bug   (NOT reused)

Step 3 is the criterion: `runner` is `pydantic_ai`, not `reused`. It also demonstrates why the defect mattered — the SAME plan BLOCKs as a task and PASSes as a bug, because bug is exempt from criteria task is not. Before this change the retype replayed the stored BLOCK, certifying a verdict that was never computed under the criteria in force. Step 2 confirms the guard did not cost legitimate reuse.

Implementation, per the operator decision to fail open rather than invalidate every attestation:
- `_type_changed` in `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/reuse.py` requires BOTH the stored and current type to be truthy before reporting a change, so a sidecar written before this check carries no usable type and reuse proceeds untouched. Those re-earn the binding the next time their plan changes.
- Wired into both reuse paths: `idempotent_reuse` (PASS) reads the sidecar for the stored type only, leaving `claim_gate_check` authoritative for everything else; `verdict_reuse` (BLOCK) checks it beside its existing base_material/base_sha guards.
- The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already recorded `ticket_type`, so no schema change was needed.

The material fingerprint is deliberately UNTOUCHED. Verified: `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py` has no diff, and the two hardcoded fingerprint SHAs at `tests/unit/test_plan_review.py:1023-1024` still pass unmodified — which is precisely what the fail-open decision preserved.

Tests (tests/unit/test_plan_review_reuse_type.py, 8 cases) pin BOTH directions. Mutation-checked: neutering the predicate to always-False reddens the three "declines" cases; dropping the truthiness guards so it fails CLOSED reddens the four fail-open cases. A later "tighten the guard" edit therefore cannot silently undo the operator decision.

Gates: make lint, make typecheck, and the reuse suites all pass. LLM-Review +1, Verified +1.
